crossRefs.note: “You, king, the Most High God gave Nebuchadnezzar your father the kingdom, and greatness, and glory, and majesty.
I will also speak of your statutes before kings, and will not be disappointed.
For John said to him, “It is not lawful for you to have her.”
Then Peter, filled with the Holy Spirit, said to them, “You rulers of the people, and elders of Israel,
Moses and Aaron went in to Pharaoh, and said to him, “This is what Yahweh, the God of the Hebrews, says: ‘How long will…
He didn’t humble himself before Yahweh, as Manasseh his father had humbled himself; but this same Amon trespassed more…
He did that which was evil in Yahweh his God’s sight. He didn’t humble himself before Jeremiah the prophet speaking…
Let favor be shown to the wicked, yet he will not learn righteousness. In the land of uprightness he will deal…
For John came to you in the way of righteousness, and you didn’t believe him, but the tax collectors and the…
But Peter and the apostles answered, “We must obey God rather than men.
Likewise, you younger ones, be subject to the elder. Yes, all of you clothe yourselves with humility, to subject…
Humble yourselves therefore under the mighty hand of God, that he may exalt you in due time,
That servant, who knew his lord’s will, and didn’t prepare, nor do what he wanted, will be beaten with many stripes,
If you know these things, blessed are you if you do them.
But he gives more grace. Therefore it says, “God resists the proud, but gives grace to the humble.”
To him therefore who knows to do good, and doesn’t do it, to him it is sin.

people.name: Belshazzar
people.line: The last Emperor of Babylon, son of Nabonidus.

translations.web: “You, his son, Belshazzar, have not humbled your heart, though you knew all this,
translations.bsb: But you his son, O Belshazzar, have not humbled your heart, even though you knew all this.
translations.kjv: And thou his son, O Belshazzar, hast not humbled thine heart, though thou knewest all this;
